description: Cambodia's National Institute of Statistics publishes the final report of the 2019 General Population Census as a 304 page English PDF, alongside Khmer versions and the 2008 and 1998 census reports. Chapter 10 covers housing, household characteristics and amenities, and an annex of province tables gives percentage distributions of households by tenure, source of light, cooking fuel, type of toilet facility, source of drinking water and rooms occupied, for every province and for urban and rural areas. Coverage is national; for example, 25.5 percent of households drink water piped into the dwelling and 25.2 percent use a tube well or borehole, and 17.2 percent have no toilet. The highlights also split buildings into permanent, semi-permanent and temporary construction. Format and access: free PDF downloads from the NIS census page, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: tables are percentages inside a PDF and stop at province level; the 2008 REDATAM database listed on the ECLAC directory returned 404. Simulation uses: provincial water source and sanitation mixes for service planning, reliance on surface water for drought exposure, and construction type for flood and storm damage estimates. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub.
